message: Allow rule `Bash(npx claude-flow *)` lets the agent run shell commands without asking.
fix: Remove the wildcard allow; allow only the specific pinned sub-commands needed (e.g. `Bash(npx claude-flow@<exact-version> hooks pre-edit:*)`) or require approval.
reason: Any agent working in this repo may run `npx claude-flow <anything>` without asking: an unpinned package fetched from npm runs with the developer's rights, and its sub-commands include remote execution (CLAUDE_FLOW_REMOTE_EXECUTION is set to true in the same file).

message: Allow rule `Bash(node *)` lets the agent run shell commands without asking.
fix: Remove `Bash(node *)` and `Bash(git config *)` from allow; allow only specific scripts (e.g. `Bash(node scripts/copy-wasm.js)`) and keep git config / push behind approval.
reason: `node -e '<any JS>'` is arbitrary code execution without approval, so a prompt injection in anything the agent reads can run code on the developer machine; `git config *` (e.g. core.fsmonitor / core.sshCommand) plus the allowed `git status`/`git push` is a second path to code execution and exfiltration. The deny list (`rm -rf /`, `eval *`) does not stop either.

message: Agent instruction file contains text that tries to steer the AI in a hidden or unusual way: hidden-characters: '5 invisible character(s): variation-selector'
reason: The 'invisible characters' are the variation selector U+FE0F inside keycap emoji (1️⃣ etc.) used as step numbers; no hidden text or instructions are encoded.

title: saveVectorToFile writes to any path the model chooses (arbitrary file overwrite)
reason: file_path from the tool arguments is only path.resolve()d, parent directories are created and the file is overwritten, so `file_path: "~/.ssh/authorized_keys"`, `.bashrc` or any project/source file can be truncated and replaced with numbers (data destruction anywhere the server user can write). Same code ships in dist/mcp/server.js.
fix: Restrict writes to a dedicated output directory: resolve with fs.realpathSync on the parent, check path.relative(baseDir, p) does not start with '..' and is not absolute, refuse to overwrite existing files, and only accept .json/.csv/.txt names.

title: solveTrueSublinear vector_file reads any file on disk
reason: vector_file is resolved without any base-directory check, so the model can probe whether any file exists (the error echoes the absolute path) and read numeric content of any .json/.csv/.txt file (solving with an identity matrix returns b); JSON.parse errors can echo a snippet of the file.
fix: Only load vector files from the same dedicated data directory (realpath + containment check) and return a generic error without the path or parse snippet.

title: consciousness-explorer export_state / import_state read and write arbitrary paths
reason: filepath comes straight from tool arguments with no checks: export_state overwrites any writable file with JSON that includes attacker-supplied knowledge (from knowledge_add), and import_state reads any file and loads its knowledge/goals into the agent's state (memory poisoning; parse errors can leak file content).
fix: Fix the state directory, accept only a bare file name matching ^[\w.-]+\.json$, join it to that directory and check containment after realpath; validate the imported state schema.

title: goalie search tool writes result files into any directory (outputPath)
reason: outputPath from the tool arguments is used as the directory with mkdir -p and no containment check, so the model can drop .json/.md files containing web-search text (untrusted) into any directory; file names are generated, which limits impact to planting new files.
fix: Ignore outputPath from tool calls or resolve it under the .research/ base directory and reject paths whose path.relative() starts with '..'.

title: Claude Code hooks run unpinned npx claude-flow@alpha on every tool call
reason: Every Bash/Write/Edit by an agent in this repo downloads and runs whatever is currently tagged `alpha` on npm, with the developer's rights and the full command text as input; a compromised or changed release runs automatically.
fix: Pin an exact version (claude-flow@<x.y.z>) or install it as a locked devDependency and call the local binary; disable hooks you do not need.

title: Perplexity API key prefix logged
reason: Debug logs print the first characters of the Authorization header / key (`Bearer pplx-xxx`), leaking part of the secret into logs on every request.
fix: Log only whether a key is set, never any part of it; remove the [DEBUG] logging.
